card.title: The Callback Changes Meaning
card.instruction: Treat every returning phrase or action as evidence the relationship has changed. Repeat it with a new emotional meaning each time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: 'Anything for you.' That's what I said when you asked for a lift.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now could we collect my piano?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Anything for you was much lighter five minutes ago.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's the piano you learned on.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Anything for you. But you're carrying the end with the memories.

mechanism: A repeats anything for you as remembered generosity, strained complaint and affectionate renewed commitment.
confusable: Unlike simple escalation of a task, each return of the phrase must shift its emotional meaning through the relationship.
comparison: S240-b lets the piano's shared history renew a favor; S240-a lets a repair need turn alarm into bounded hospitality.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
